title: Attention Is All You Need
venue: NeurIPS 2017 (Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems)
abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks in an encoder-decoder configuration. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.

title: Quantum Error Correction Below the Surface Code Threshold with Willow
abstract: Building a fault-tolerant quantum computer requires physical error rates below the threshold where increasing code distance exponentially reduces logical error rates. Here we demonstrate a 105-qubit superconducting quantum processor named Willow, achieving distance-3, distance-5, and distance-7 surface code memory below the fault-tolerance threshold, halving the logical error rate with each step in code size.

title: Accurate Structure Prediction of Biomolecular Interactions with AlphaFold 3
abstract: Here we introduce AlphaFold 3, with a substantially updated diffusion-based architecture capable of predicting the joint structure of complexes including proteins, nucleic acids (DNA and RNA), small molecules, ions, and chemical modifications. AlphaFold 3 achieves unprecedented accuracy across diverse biomolecular interactions, substantially improving protein-ligand binding pose prediction compared with traditional docking tools.

title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
abstract: We present Gemini, a new family of highly capable multimodal models trained jointly across image, audio, video, and text modalities. Gemini Ultra achieves state-of-the-art results on 30 of 32 widely-used academic benchmarks, including being the first model to outperform human experts on MMLU (Massive Multitask Language Understanding) with a score of 90.04%.

title: Learning Skillful Medium-Range Global Weather Forecasting with GraphCast
abstract: Global medium-range weather forecasting is critical to decision-making across society. We introduce GraphCast, a machine learning-based weather forecasting system that generates 10-day global forecasts at 0.25-degree resolution in under one minute on a single TPU. GraphCast outperforms the world's premier operational deterministic system on 90.3% of 1,380 verification targets.

title: Capabilities of Gemini Models in Medicine
abstract: Generalist multimodal AI models have the potential to assist clinicians across diverse diagnostic and operational tasks. We present Med-Gemini, a family of multimodal models fine-tuned and equipped with web-search retrieval and long-context capabilities for clinical medicine. Med-Gemini achieves 91.1% on MedQA (USMLE), outperforming previous state-of-the-art models while demonstrating physician-level performance in radiology report generation and clinical summarization.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
abstract: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks.

title: TPU v4: An Optically Reconfigurable Supercomputer for Machine Learning with Hardware Support for Embeddings
venue: ISCA 2023 (ACM/IEEE International Symposium on Computer Architecture)
abstract: We describe Google's TPU v4 supercomputer, which integrates 4,096 chips interconnected via custom optical circuit switches (OCS) to dynamically configure topologies. TPU v4 supercomputers provide 10x speedup and 2-3x better energy efficiency compared to contemporary contemporary accelerators, powering Google's most demanding training workloads including PaLM and Gemini.
